motion_rule: the cart rolls down the market lane the whole clip and never stops; stalls, crates and shoppers tear past the lens every beat; the camera tracks alongside; new shot size each beat, never wider than her muzzle on a third of frame; ONE sideways move per beat, never up or down
character: a wiry macaque in a grey waistcoat riding that rolling cart deck, exactly two arms, muzzle and jaw always clear
second_characters: ONE rat porter on the same deck a shoulder from the lens, crossing frame every beat, digging the sacks open from 3.85, never touching her
props: ONE brass balance on a post bolted to the cart deck, two identical pans; ONE red sack and ONE blue sack, same cloth and size; A SWARM of paper slips
prop_continuity: the balance rides on the cart; the sacks differ only in colour; the pans never part from level after 2.85
environment: a packed market lane under a glass roof, fruit stalls tight both sides, shoppers diving out of the cart path
light_events: flat white noon off the boards, a side shaft on the flying slips

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: a level pleased female voice, biting off each word, even 4.0 syllables/sec, beats filled edge to edge
audio.pronunciation: ba-LANS, so-SHOL-sya, PROS-to, o-BE-ikh, sto-RON, dol-GI
audio.pacing: 0.00-1.25 and 1.60-3.85 each one breath, first word at 0.00; the gap under a second; after 3.85 not a word, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: her jaw opens on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: cart wheels hammering the stones all clip, the market roaring, paper slips flapping

timeline.a: the cart drives her at the lens, a sack swinging from each hand
she swings the red one across frame into the near pan, the lane tearing past
the cart splits the crowd and a crate sweeps past the lens
she kicks a tray off a passing stall and fruit sprays across frame
she swings the blue one across frame into the far pan
both pans ride level past the lens side by side
she throws both hands out empty, her muzzle at the lens
the rat dives into the red one a shoulder from the lens and slips blow out past it
he hauls a fistful of slips across frame and flings them at the lens
he leaps to the blue one and rips it open on the way
slips blow out of that one too and sweep the lane past the lens
the pans ride dead level between the bare sacks, she drives her muzzle at the lens, her face not changing
the rat runs the deck the other way past the lens, slips whipping after him
still rolling she tips both pans at the lens and slips pour out of both at once
the slips sweep the lane past the lens, the crowd batting them away
the cart drives her into the lens, the beam level, her face not changing

must_appear: the cart rolls in every beat and the lane sweeps past behind her; the balance rides on that cart; the red one in the near pan, the blue one in the far pan; the rat opens both and the same slips blow out of each; the pans stay level from 2.85 to the last frame; at 6.60 and 9.30 her muzzle is at the lens; every word spoken, the last by 3.85
negative_prompt: subtitles, watermark, letterbox, horizontal frame, a static camera, a still background, a parked cart, a hero hanging from a fixed rail, a hero standing to work on a prop, a balance on the ground, standing bystanders, a wide or distant hero, a hero moving up or down the frame, slow motion, letters, writing, digits, a closed jaw while speaking, extra limbs, a third arm, multiple monkeys
